prompts.agents: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 photographic supporting scene for a high-school AI literacy video. Candid editorial realism in the style of a thoughtful student visibly revising real work, natural warm window light, mature restrained composition, ordinary clothing, realistic proportions and hands. A 17-year-old student basketball player wearing a plain muted blue T-shirt sits at a home study desk, seen in three-quarter over-shoulder view from slightly above. Their right hand is on the laptop trackpad and their attention is on the screen, reviewing their basketball highlight reel. Laptop occupies center-right with a large unobstructed screen nearly square to the camera; entire screen corners visible, screen blank dark navy for separately composited exact editor content. Student on left, face partially in profile with natural focused expression. A basketball sits beside the desk in background. No readable text, no logos, no floating UI, no robot, no trophies, no approval buttons. Tight enough framing to make the laptop and student action clear, but keep both hands and whole laptop visible. Real texture, gentle daylight, no cartoon or drawing, no futuristic lighting. Create one image.
prompts.facility: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 photographic-style teaching illustration of an ordinary large data center exterior, not a real named site. A clear slightly elevated three-quarter view of a modern low warehouse-scale data center building. Rectangular simple building, orderly rooftop and adjacent air-cooling equipment, an electrical substation off to one side, service road with one ordinary maintenance vehicle for scale. Daylight, realistic engineering proportions, neutral concrete and muted natural colors, documentary editorial composition, no dramatic mood. Show a coherent computing facility, not a power generating station. No hyperboloid cooling towers, smokestacks, steam plumes, giant pylons, company names, place names, statistics, logos, captions, watermarks, or readable signs. Keep the main facility large in frame and immediately recognizable within four seconds. Single clean composition, no collage or split panels.
prompts.study: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 photographic supporting scene for a high-school AI literacy video. Candid mature editorial realism, natural warm classroom/library window light and muted colors, ordinary clothes, real hands, no posed stock-photo smile. A focused 17-year-old girl wearing an olive overshirt at a library study table, working through a problem herself. View from slightly above and three-quarter side. She writes with a pencil on the right page of an open notebook, while her other hand follows a simple diagram in an open textbook to the left. Notebook pages mostly clean pale paper with a few subtle gray lines only, no legible text or math, so exact study steps can be typeset separately. Keep notebook unobstructed in lower-center and right with visible corners and enough space around pencil. Face and both hands visible, textbook and notebook are the focal work. A closed laptop sits toward the far back of the desk. Calm believable shelves behind. No floating text, robot, new people, branding, badges, glowing screens, cartoon, illustration look, or watermark. Show actual learning, not just sitting at a computer. Single image.
prompts.basketball: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: video frame to appear inside a laptop basketball highlight editor in a high-school educational video. Landscape 16:9. Realistic candid school basketball action photograph: a teenage boy in a plain navy sleeveless basketball uniform making a layup near the basket in an ordinary high-school gym, one defender in muted light grey slightly behind him, hardwood court, hoop and backboard visible, other players distant and softly out of focus. Natural indoor gym lighting. Clearly readable action and realistic ball, limbs and court relationships. Medium-wide camera from sideline. No logos, readable scoreboard, slogans, watermarks, giant crowd, jersey text or numbers. It must look like a frame from a friend's recording, not a professional commercial. Do not imply any particular real person.
prompts.study_before: Edit target: the supplied photographic student study scene. Create the earlier matched state: the exact same student, face, olive overshirt, desk, notebook, textbook, library, camera, lighting and framing. She is making her own first attempt in the notebook, looking at that notebook; her left hand rests lightly near the notebook spine instead of pointing into the textbook. The textbook stays open exactly where it is. Keep right hand holding pencil over the same notebook page. Keep the visible notebook writing area clean and unobstructed for later typesetting; a few very faint lines, no readable words or math. Change only her gaze and left-hand position. Do not introduce new objects or alter the room, skin, clothing, perspective or lighting.
